note: Supervisor or user source files that live OUTSIDE this workspace and may be admitted ONLY as the listed line ranges, through `python tools/origin_extract.py --intake-source ID --lines A-B`. An entry exists only after the human authorizes the specific file and ranges in ops/AUTHORIZATIONS.md (field `authorization` cites that AUTH id; AUTH-001/002 do not count). The lead records the entry; agents cannot edit config/**. Required fields: id (INT-NNN), path (absolute), sha256 (whole file), total_lines (LF count), allowed_ranges ([[first,last],...], 1-based inclusive), authorization, supplied_by, supplied_utc, form (transcript|notes|message), source_identity (what the file is: name, meeting, date, as stated by the supplier), stated_nature (what the supplier says it is). Optional: locator_note (for example how line numbers map to the transcript's own time-codes), caveats (for example ASR quality). Lines outside allowed_ranges are never written anywhere; `tools/verify_workspace.py` hashes the original, and flags exact long lines of the excluded part that appear in any workspace file. See requirements/intake/README.md. Empty until the human authorizes a file.
